scores.reason: Line 43 renders `<DataGridCell>{network.status}</DataGridCell>` as plain text, and NetworkDetailsView.tsx:116 does the same. copilot-instructions B.1 says status indicators use `Badge`, so this is a verified standards violation with cosmetic impact.

Line 46 renders t`UP` / t`DOWN` (same at NetworkDetailsView.tsx:117). The Quick Reject checklist lists a 'String using ... all-caps' item, and the UX writing rules say 'Never all-caps (ever)'. This is a different problem from C8 (wording, not component choice); Low per the precedent table.
Lines 132-133 use t`Created At` and t`Updated At`. The title-case rule keeps short prepositions such as 'at' lowercase, so this is verified. It is only a wording nit, so 50 and Low.

Lines 36-38 use a useEffect to copy the currentPage prop into inputPage state. This is the prop-to-state sync that copilot-instructions A.1 ('Minimize useEffect') says to flag. The only cost is an extra render, so Low.

The effect at NetworksList.tsx:97-99 triggers a URL navigation (onPageChange(1)) as a side effect, which cannot be done during render. The render already clamps with safePage, so this is not derived state. The A.1 quote does not clearly apply.
